en.title: Bachelor's in Computer Science
en.text: Completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science with a strong academic record (CGPA: 3.7/4.0). The program provided a solid foundation in core computer science concepts along with advanced exposure to artificial intelligence and data-driven technologies.

es.title: Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación
es.institution: Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences & Technology, Islamabad
es.text: Completé una licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación con un sólido rendimiento académico (CGPA: 3.7/4.0). El programa proporcionó una base sólida en conceptos fundamentales de informática y una exposición avanzada a la inteligencia artificial y tecnologías basadas en datos.

fr.title: Licence en Informatique
fr.institution: Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences & Technology, Islamabad
fr.text: J’ai obtenu une licence en informatique avec d’excellents résultats académiques (CGPA : 3,7/4,0). Le programme m’a permis d’acquérir une base solide en informatique ainsi qu’une exposition avancée à l’intelligence artificielle et aux technologies basées sur les données.

ko.title: 컴퓨터 공학 학사
ko.institution: Federal Urdu University of Arts, Sciences & Technology, Islamabad
ko.text: 컴퓨터 공학 학사 과정을 우수한 성적으로 졸업하였으며 (CGPA: 3.7/4.0), 핵심 컴퓨터 과학 개념과 함께 인공지능 및 데이터 기반 기술에 대한 심화 학습을 수행했습니다.

en.title: Higher Secondary School (Pre-Engineering)
en.institution: Islamabad Model Post Graduate College H-8/4, Islamabad
en.text: Completed Higher Secondary Education in Pre-Engineering with Grade B, building a strong foundation in mathematics and physics. This phase helped develop analytical thinking and problem-solving skills essential for engineering studies.

es.title: Educación Secundaria Superior (Pre-Ingeniería)
es.institution: Islamabad Model Post Graduate College H-8/4, Islamabad
es.text: Completé la educación secundaria superior en pre-ingeniería con calificación de Grado B, con una sólida base en matemáticas y física. Esta etapa fortaleció mis habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas.

fr.title: Enseignement secondaire supérieur (Pré-ingénierie)
fr.institution: Islamabad Model Post Graduate College H-8/4, Islamabad
fr.text: J’ai terminé l’enseignement secondaire supérieur en pré-ingénierie avec la mention B, avec une solide base en mathématiques et physique. Cette période a renforcé mes compétences analytiques et ma capacité à résoudre des problèmes.

ko.title: 고등학교 (프리엔지니어링)
ko.institution: Islamabad Model Post Graduate College H-8/4, Islamabad
ko.text: Pre-Engineering 과정에서 B 학점을 취득하였으며, 수학과 물리를 중심으로 학업을 수행했습니다. 이 과정은 분석적 사고력과 문제 해결 능력을 발전시키는 데 도움이 되었습니다.

en.title: Secondary School Certificate (Computer Science)
en.institution: Islamabad Model College for Boys, G-7/2, Islamabad
en.text: Completed Secondary School Certificate in Computer Science with Grade A, building a strong foundation in mathematics and basic computer science concepts. This phase helped develop logical thinking, analytical ability, and problem-solving skills.

es.title: Certificado de Educación Secundaria (Informática)
es.institution: Islamabad Model College for Boys, G-7/2, Islamabad
es.text: Completé el Certificado de Educación Secundaria en informática con calificación de Grado A, con una sólida base en matemáticas y conceptos básicos de computación. Esta etapa desarrolló habilidades de pensamiento lógico y resolución de problemas.

fr.title: Certificat de fin d’études secondaires (Informatique)
fr.institution: Islamabad Model College for Boys, G-7/2, Islamabad
fr.text: J’ai obtenu le certificat de fin d’études secondaires en informatique avec la mention A, avec une solide base en mathématiques et concepts informatiques de base. Cette étape a renforcé mes capacités de raisonnement logique et de résolution de problèmes.

ko.title: 중등학교 졸업 (컴퓨터 과학)
ko.institution: Islamabad Model College for Boys, G-7/2, Islamabad
ko.text: 컴퓨터 과학 과목에서 A 등급으로 중등학교 교육을 이수하였으며, 수학과 기초 컴퓨터 과학을 중심으로 학업을 수행했습니다. 이 과정은 논리적 사고력과 문제 해결 능력을 발전시키는 기반이 되었습니다.
